    Diagram contradictions from MildHyp #

    MildHyp versions of the generic cleaving contradictions of the BO13a work (MulBasis.not_thin_diagram, MulBasis.not_ot_diagram, MulBasis.not_tree_table), which only used the representation-finiteness of proper residues. The proofs apply with the hypothesis replaced.
